experience.role: AI/ML Engineer, Contract — Production RAG Knowledge Assistant
experience.description: Deployment: Shipped a client-facing RAG assistant answering live product, service, and pricing queries. Retrieval: Built a ChromaDB vector store with section-aware chunking and nomic-embed-text embeddings for source-attributed answers. Reliability: Added metadata-based routing and an LLM-judged fallback, replacing hardcoded confidence thresholds. Infrastructure: Served via FastAPI, deployed on a Mac Mini behind a secured Cloudflare Tunnel.

Microservices: Engineered backend REST and GraphQL microservices in Node.js and FastAPI powering a multi-tenant enterprise portal. Frontend: Developed responsive, accessible dashboard UIs using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with real-time state synchronization via TanStack Query and WebSockets. Cloud & DevOps: Containerized services using Docker and orchestrated deployments on AWS ECS and EKS with automated CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions. Database Optimization: Scaled PostgreSQL relational databases and implemented Redis caching layers, cutting 95th percentile query latencies by 45%.

Perception & Deep Learning: Trained and fine-tuned real-time YOLOv8 object detection and semantic segmentation models using PyTorch and OpenCV for autonomous ground navigation. Edge Acceleration: Optimized model inference on NVIDIA Jetson Orin and Xavier platforms using TensorRT and ONNX, achieving 60+ FPS at under 15W power draw. Robotics Integration: Integrated sensor streams (LiDAR, RGB-D cameras, IMU) through ROS2 communication nodes in C++ and Python with custom Kalman filter tracking. Low-Level Optimization: Authored multi-threaded C++ camera ingestion pipelines with zero-copy shared memory queues.

Data Ingestion & Streaming: Constructed scalable streaming and batch ETL pipelines processing 10M+ events daily using Apache Kafka and Apache Spark. Workflow Orchestration: Authored automated DAGs in Apache Airflow for data ingestion, deduplication, and loading into Snowflake and BigQuery data warehouses. MLOps Lifecycle: Standardized model tracking, artifact versioning, and registry deployment using MLflow and Docker containers with automated drift detection alerts. Quality & Governance: Enforced schema validation using Great Expectations and automated SQL data transformation models with dbt.
